svg.title: Prithvi Raghu: research and selected work
svg.desc: I research quantum machine learning and scientific computing. I study quantum circuits for learning, games and option pricing. I also model HF propagation for emitter geolocation. Quantum games (QHD): restricted GHZ equilibria admit unrestricted deviations, with compact payoff evaluation and recorded IBM Heron experiments in a co-authored manuscript. Quantum ML (FQCNN): coherent-pooling equivalence and four-task simulator benchmarks, with classical-baseline comparisons documented in a co-authored manuscript. Option pricing (QOP): Asian-basket encodings trade qubits against gate count, with reproducible logical-resource comparisons and a manuscript draft. HF geolocation: a two-pass geolocation pipeline and Gaussian-process correction, evaluated on simulated emitter geometry with explicit limitations.
